title: Basic Investor instance configuration
description: Reaches the agent as AgentInvocation.config. Every field bounds how much the agent gathers before it reasons; none of them can loosen the TimeGate, which is the gateway's and not configurable from here.

historyDays.description: Calendar days of daily bars to request, counting back from asOf.

newsLimit.description: Maximum articles to request. Articles published or revised after asOf are excluded by the gateway regardless.
